name: Activehotel Bergkönig
beschreibung: The **Activehotel Bergkönig** is located in **Neustift im Stubaital**, right next to the valley station of the **Stubai Glacier Cable Car**. This accommodation operates as an **active hotel**, offering guests direct access to the hiking, cycling, and skiing trails of the valley. The property features a **wellness area** with a sauna and swimming pool. Dining is handled by the hotel’s own **restaurant**, serving regional cuisine. Rooms vary in amenities, with some offering balconies. Ski and mountain sports equipment rentals are available on-site. The hotel is ideal for sports enthusiasts.
